issues.on_page: Support services - students: Other property services 325,730
issues.issue: Every 'Other property services' object line (detail[36], [48], [58], [71], [77], [84], [88], [100], plus the School Nutrition 0 line) is mapped to professional/contract services. 'Purchased property services' goes to repairs and maintenance, or to construction/infrastructure in Special Building. This is a judgment call; the largest such line is 325,730 under Support services - students.
